description: How an older event is read as the current version. A published version is never edited; a reader upcasts on the way in (contract/upcast.py is the reference; TypeScript, Rust, Kotlin and Swift port the same rules and the shared vectors prove them).

upcasters.rule: Version 1 knew one currency: every amount was an integer RWF, and RWF has no minor unit, so a version 1 amount is already an integer in its minor unit. The upcaster sets schema_version to 2 and adds currency "RWF" to every payload that carries money and had no currency field (PaymentRecorded, ReturnRecorded, ProductCreated). SaleRecorded already carried its currency. Nothing else changes: no amount is rescaled, no field is removed, the signature and hash chain of the stored version 1 event stay as they were, because the upcast is applied when the event is read, never written back.

Version 3 adds an optional side to every payload: internal (the workspace, using a service for one's own affairs) or external (the Storefront, offering to others and earning). Every version 2 event was written before Storefronts existed, so the upcaster sets schema_version to 3 and side "internal" when the payload has none. Nothing else changes: no field is removed or renamed, no amount is touched, and the stored version 2 event, its signature and its hash chain stay as they were, because the upcast is applied when the event is read, never written back.

Version 4 only adds the milestone events of LynkTrace, LynkGPS and LynkSentry and the commands that issue them. A version 3 event reads as version 4 unchanged: the upcaster raises schema_version and touches nothing else. No position is ever part of an event.

Version 5 only adds the LynkVCard card request (online only) and the partner's answer, and corrects the session policy so cash selling continues after the offline limit. A version 4 event reads as version 5 unchanged: the upcaster raises schema_version and touches nothing else.

Version 6 only adds the events of LynkAttend, LynkQueue and LynkSurvey and the class A commands that issue the ones a device may write. A version 5 event reads as version 6 unchanged: the upcaster raises schema_version and touches nothing else.
never: add a PIN, IDCN, ID number, face or finger pattern, phone number, position or anonymous identity

upcasters.rule: Version 7 only adds the Emulator Panel's events and the device's own panel commands, and LynkSurvey's "You said, we did" message. A version 6 event reads as version 7 unchanged: the upcaster raises schema_version and touches nothing else.

upcasters.agreed: 2026-11-19 (owner: WhatsApp removed from the whole ecosystem)
upcasters.rule: Version 8 only removes WhatsApp as a way in LynkAttend, LynkQueue and LynkSurvey events. A version 7 event reads as version 8 with schema_version raised; a value that names WhatsApp reads as LynkChat (only sandbox and test events can hold one; there were no live users). The stored event is never rewritten.
